crs: TWD97 / TM2 zone 121 + TWVD 2001 height - EPSG:3826+8904 [TWGEOID2018h]
ai_model: Gemini 3.5 Flash Multimodal + Ground Photo Referee
ai_summary_zh: 本次三維光達與空拍量測記錄包含6條道路廊道（總面積3,725.4平方公尺）、38棵經人工與視覺驗證之喬木（平均胸徑25.5公分）、2處水體空洞（總面積1,330.0平方公尺）以及39處擋土牆與建築外牆。系統已排除25處誤判之非樹木物件。
ai_summary_en: The 3D LiDAR and photogrammetry survey documents 6 road corridors totaling 3,725.4 m2, 38 vision-verified trees with a mean DBH of 25.5 cm, 2 water body/canal voids spanning 1,330.0 m2, and 39 retaining or building walls. A total of 25 false-positive tree detections were successfully rejected.
